  # Try CRAN first
  tryCatch({
    install.packages("omicwas", repos = "https://cran.r-project.org")
    return(TRUE)
  }, error = function(e1) {
    print(paste("CRAN installation failed:", e1$message))

    tryCatch({
      if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
        install.packages("BiocManager")
      }
      BiocManager::install("omicwas")
      return(TRUE)
    }, error = function(e2) {
      print(paste("BiocManager installation failed:", e2$message))
      
      # Try GitHub installation
      tryCatch({
        if (!require("devtools", quietly = TRUE)) {
          install.packages("devtools")
        }
        devtools::install_github("cran/omicwas")
        return(TRUE)
      }, error = function(e3) {
        print(paste("GitHub installation failed:", e3$message))
        return(FALSE)
      })
    })
  })
}

# Attempt installation

# Check original dimensions

print(paste("Ypos (CpG positions):", paste(dim(Ypos), collapse=" x ")))

# Since we have different numbers of SNPs (31) and CpG sites (6), we need to

for (i in 1:nrow(Ypos)) {
  cpg_chr <- Ypos[i, "chr"]
  cpg_pos <- Ypos[i, "pos"]
  
  for (j in 1:nrow(Xpos)) {
    snp_chr <- Xpos[j, "chr"]
    snp_pos <- Xpos[j, "pos"]
    
    # Check if on same chromosome and within 1 Mb
    if (cpg_chr == snp_chr && abs(cpg_pos - snp_pos) <= 1e6) {
      cis_pairs <- rbind(cis_pairs, data.frame(
        snp_id = rownames(Xpos)[j],

        snp_chr = snp_chr,
        snp_pos = snp_pos,

        cpg_pos = cpg_pos,

      ))
    }
  }

  C_ordered <- C[common_samples, ]
  
  # Combine cell type compositions and covariates
  covariates_matrix <- t(cbind(W_ordered, C_ordered))

  snps = SlicedData$new()
  snps$CreateFromMatrix(as.matrix(snps_matrix))
  
  gene = SlicedData$new()
  gene$CreateFromMatrix(as.matrix(gene_matrix))
  
  cvrt = SlicedData$new()
  cvrt$CreateFromMatrix(as.matrix(covariates_matrix))

    chr = Xpos$chr,
    pos = Xpos$pos
  )
  
  genepos <- data.frame(
    geneid = rownames(Ypos),
    chr = Ypos$chr,
    s1 = Ypos$pos,
    s2 = Ypos$pos
  )
  
  # Run MatrixEQTL analysis
  output_file <- file.path(outdir, "mQTL_results.tsv")
  
  me = Matrix_eQTL_main(
    snps = snps,
    gene = gene,
    cvrt = cvrt,
    output_file_name = output_file,
    pvOutputThreshold = 1,  # Output all results
    useModel = modelLINEAR,
    snpspos = snpspos,
    genepos = genepos,
    cisDist = 1e6,  # 1 Mb cis distance
    pvalue.hist = FALSE,
    min.pv.by.genesnp = FALSE,
    noFDRsaveMemory = FALSE
  )
  
  print("MatrixEQTL analysis completed!")
  print(paste("Number of cis-eQTLs found:", me$cis$neqtls))
  
  # Read and format results
  if (file.exists(output_file)) {
    results <- read.table(output_file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    # Add cell type information (this is a simplified approach)
    # For proper cell-type-specific analysis, we would need to run separate analyses
    # or use interaction terms
    results$celltype <- "bulk"  # Since this is bulk analysis
    
    # Rename columns to match expected format
    colnames(results)[colnames(results) == "snps"] <- "term"
    colnames(results)[colnames(results) == "gene"] <- "response"
    
    # Reorder columns
    final_results <- results[, c("term", "response", "celltype", "beta", "statistic", "pvalue")]
    colnames(final_results) <- c("term", "response", "celltype", "estimate", "statistic", "p.value")
    
    # Save formatted results
    write.table(final_results, output_file, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
    
    print("Results formatted and saved!")
    print(paste("Output file:", output_file))
    print("First few results:")
    print(head(final_results))
  }

  # Try to use ctcisQTL with matched pairs

  # For ctcisQTL, we need to create matrices with matching SNP-CpG pairs
